overview.de: When Eve (Meg Ryan) isn't being pulled in a million directions by her own life, she's being sucked into lengthy phone conversations with her cranky father (Walter Matthau) or her two sisters, successful magazine entrepreneur Georgia (Diane Keaton) and career-challenged Maddy (Lisa Kudrow). As the family becomes more and more dependent on Eve, transforming her into the human swi...
overview.en: When Eve (Meg Ryan) isn't being pulled in a million directions by her own life, she's being sucked into lengthy phone conversations with her cranky father (Walter Matthau) or her two sisters, successful magazine entrepreneur Georgia (Diane Keaton) and career-challenged Maddy (Lisa Kudrow). As the family becomes more and more dependent on Eve, transforming her into the human swi...

overview.de: Als Polizeibeamte kennen Adam Mitchell, Nathan Hayes und ihre Partner die Abgründe des Menschen, doch einer Herausforderung scheinen sie nicht recht gewachsen zu sein: der Vaterschaft. Während sie im Beruf ihr Bestes geben, merken sie, wie sich ihre Kinder immer mehr von ihnen entfremden. Eine persönliche Tragödie weckt in diesen Männern den Wunsch, ihren Glauben zu erneuern und ihre Kinder wie..
overview.en: As law enforcement officers, Adam Mitchell, Nathan Hayes, and their partners are confident and focused. They willingly stand up to the worst the world can offer. Yet at the end of the day, they face a challenge that none of them are truly prepared to tackle: fatherhood. While they consistently give their best on the job, good enough seems to be all they can muster as dads. But they're quickly...

overview.de: Die pensionierte Anwältin Madeline infiltriert eine New Yorker Kanzlei. Sie will ihre Tochter rächen, die an einer Opioid-Überdosis gestorben ist. Sie glaubt, dass die Kanzlei Beweise gegen das Pharmaunternehmen vertuscht hat.
overview.en: Brilliant septuagenarian Madeline Matlock decides to rejoin the workforce at a prestigious law firm where she uses her unassuming demeanour and wily tactics to win cases and expose corruption from within.

overview.de: Der Undercover-Einsatz zweier tollpatschiger FBI-Agenten soll die reichen Wilton-Schwestern vor einer Entführung schützen.
overview.en: FBI agents Kevin and Marcus disguise themselves as white socialites to solve a kidnapping plot. Posing as the wealthy Wilson sisters, the duo must infiltrate high society while keeping their true identities—and mission—a secret.

title.en: Schumacher '94 - The Birth of a Legend

overview.de: The Hunting Wives enthüllt eine skandalöse Geschichte von Besessenheit, Lust und tödlichen Geheimnissen in einer Kleinstadt in Osttexas, beruhend auf dem gleichnamigen Buch von May Cobb.
overview.en: Sophie O'Neil and her family move from the East Coast to deep East Texas, where she succumbs to socialite Margo Bank's irresistible charms – and finds her life consumed by obsession, seduction, and murder.
Four strangers' lives intersect over three decades as they confront grief and hope after the 1995 Kobe and 2011 Tohoku quakes and the COVID-19 pandemic.

overview.de: Die Brüder Mitch und Mike McLusky stehen zwischen den Bewohnern von Kingstown, Michigan und den Gefängnisinsassen der Stadt, und versuchen Frieden zu bewahren, während sie sich mit Mördern, Drogendealern und der russischen Mafia auseinandersetzen.
overview.en: A crime drama about an important contemporary issue, America's prison system, "Mayor of Kingstown" follows the McLusky family in Kingstown, Mich., where the business of incarceration is the only thriving industry; the family of power brokers between police, criminals, inmates, prison guards and politicians tackle themes of systemic racism, corruption and inequality; the crime thriller series provides a stark look at their attempt to bring order and justice to a town that has neither.

overview.de: Robert De Niro spielt in einer Doppelrolle zwei Mafiabosse: Im New York der 50er kämpfen Frank Costello und Vito Genovese um die Macht in der Cosa Nostra. Inszeniert von Barry Levinson.
overview.en: The Alto Knights stars Academy Award winner Robert De Niro in a dual role, directed by Academy Award-winning filmmaker Barry Levinson.

Chris, a thirty-something gas station employee, lives in North Carolina with his girlfriend Mimi, a live-sized 'love doll', who he communicates with through an AI app. An open-hearted and fascinating take on machine learning, the rising levels of loneliness and the social implications of trying to form a human bond with technology. From the award-winning team behind Sundance hit Finders Keepers.
Satsuki Kakeru lived an ordinary life, until one day - with childhood friend Minase Yuka - they are transported to a different world.

overview.de: Auf dem Höhepunkt des Krieges erhalten die beiden britischen Soldaten Schofield und Blake einen nahezu unmöglichen Auftrag. In einem Wettlauf gegen die Zeit müssen sie sich tief ins Feindesgebiet vorwagen und eine Nachricht überbringen, die verhindern soll, dass hunderte ihrer Kameraden in eine tödliche Falle geraten – darunter auch Blakes eigener Bruder.
overview.en: During World War I, two British soldiers attempt to cross enemy lines to deliver a message that could save many lives, including one's own brother.
In this reimagining of the classic novel, an unhinged submarine captain searches fanatically for the prehistoric whale that took his leg.

After leaving the Special Forces, truck driver and single father Hùng (Alexandre Nguyen) dedicates his life to raising his six-year-old daughter. But when she gets kidnapped, Hùng relies on his supreme martial arts training and combat skills and embarks on a perilous journey deep into the Vietnamese underworld to hunt down the twisted millionaire responsible.

Sigurdur Thordarson, otherwise known as Siggi, is the pivotal center in a crazy story of paranoia, intelligence agencies, hacking, abuse, friendship and betrayal, and a heartbreaking coming of age story.
In this outrageous comedy, a group of high school Seniors juggle between old loves and new flings on the shores of a beautiful Italian town.

overview.de: Der gestandene Musiker Jackson Maine entdeckt die erfolglose Künstlerin Ally – und verliebt sich in sie. Sie hat ihren Traum Sängerin zu werden schon fast aufgegeben, bis Jack sie ins Rampenlicht lockt.
overview.en: Seasoned musician Jackson Maine discovers-and falls in love with-struggling artist Ally. She has just about given up on her dream as a singer until Jack coaxes her into the spotlight.

The reunion of seven friends takes a deadly turn when old tensions resurface, leading to a murder. Trust is shattered, turning friends into enemies, and they must unravel the mystery behind the murder.

Shot in six cities along the Trans-Siberian railway, this documentary follows queer Irish filmmaker Paul Rice and his boyfriend Liam, as they go undercover to meet with members of the LGBTQ+ community in Russia. They reveal deeply personal and moving accounts from activists and non-activists alike, who risk everything to live authentically and survive under oppressive laws and harsh prejudices.
When a young woman on the run is forced to hide out at a smart home, she becomes terrorized by ROMI, its sinister digital assistant.
When the security guard of a neglected medical clinic is terrorized by the ghosts of murder victims, she enlists a doctor and a cop to investigate.

"Dante, The Great", a prestigious magician, accidentally dies during a risky magic trick. Thirty-five years later his son Lorenzo, also a magician, presents a magic show in one of the most important theaters in the city. From then on, a series of murders will begin to take place and will attempt to incriminate him. Lorenzo must discover who and why seeks to involve him before it is too late...
After being declared dead in absentia, an FBI agent reappears after six years and sets out to reclaim her family, identity and prove her innocence, as the prime suspect in a string of murders.

The new reality of artificial life. As tech companies race to dominate the artificial intelligence market, experts warn we're not prepared for what happens next. Grace Tobin investigates the misuse and abuse of generative AI.
Based on the exploits of the famed Greek, young Alexander III conquers the world and becomes one of the most legendary leaders in human history.

Delve into the Roswell coverup, exploring eyewitness accounts, government secrets, and declassified files. Uncover the truth behind one of history's most mysterious events that sparked decades of debate and inspired countless theories.

Mysterious lights in the sky have fueled wonder and speculation throughout history. From Rendlesham Forest to the Roswell Incident, Marfa Lights to the Battle of Los Angeles, are these phenomena natural, man-made, or proof of extraterrestrial visitors?
A frustrated novelist enters an absurd world of literary hypocrisy and acclaim after penning a joke book built on tired Black stereotypes he disdains.

overview.de: Basierend auf dem gleichnamigen Originalfilm erzählt dieses Remake die wahre Geschichte eines großen Hauses an der Küste Long Islands, wo ein frisch verheiratetes Paar mit ihren drei Kindern einzieht, ohne zu wissen, dass vor Jahren in dem Haus ein Mord geschah. Schon bald passieren seltsame und unerklärliche Dinge, sie haben alptraumhafte Visionen - in dem Haus spukt es.
overview.en: Strange events plague a family (Ryan Reynolds, Melissa George, Jesse James) in a new house.
From a small-town prodigy shaped by tragedy to a Grand Slam champion and Olympic hero, follow the British tennis pro and coach’s path to greatness.

Who is Angela Merkel? What motivates and inspires her? Merkel remains a puzzle to the German public, when, after ten years of carefully calculated steps, of "politics of hesitation", she takes unprecedented action during the European refugee crisis. This documentary follows her political biography - from an East German physicist to the most powerful woman in the world.

During a routine check, two police officers accidentally come across Gabriel Engel, a brutal psychopath who is suspected of having killed more than 15 male youths by bleeding them and painting religious pictures with their blood. The reinforcements called in succeed in arresting the serial killer. But the problems are just beginning.

overview.de: Vor über 100 Jahren wurde die Menschheit fast vollständig von humanoiden, menschenfressenden Giganten, den sogenannten Titanen, ausgelöscht. Um sich zu schützen, zogen sich die Überlebenden in von riesigen Mauern umschlossene Städte zurück. Eren Jäger lebt zusammen mit seiner Adoptivschwester Mikasa Ackermann und seinem besten Freund Armin Arlert in der Stadt Shinganshina.
overview.en: From the director of Death Note comes Attack on Titan. Many years ago, humanity was forced to retreat behind the towering walls of a fortified city to escape the massive, man-eating Titans that roamed the land outside their fortress. This is their story.
A U.N. employee uncovers a vast global conspiracy while investigating the murder of his predecessor.

title.de: Barbara Rubin and the Exploding NY Underground
title.en: Barbara Rubin and the Exploding NY Underground

overview.en: The unbelievable story of an avant garde filmmaking ingenue and New York underground scenester turned Orthodox Jew who died mysteriously at age 35.
A deadly, supernatural force is unleashed underground with a crew of trapped coal miners and a female environmentalist in this horror thriller.

title.de: Berlin - Paris: Die Geschichte der Beate Klarsfeld
title.en: Berlin - Paris: Die Geschichte der Beate Klarsfeld

overview.en: Based on the runaway bestseller, WHERE'D YOU GO, BERNADETTE is an inspiring comedy about Bernadette Fox (Academy Award winner Cate Blanchett), a loving mom who becomes compelled to reconnect with her creative passions after years of sacrificing herself for her family. Bernadette's leap of faith takes her on an epic adventure that jump-starts her life and leads to her triumphant rediscovery.
A precocious young blind woman chases down love and freedom in the most unexpected of places -- a provocative fringe community.

title.de: Birds of Prey - The Emancipation of Harley Quinn
title.en: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)

overview.de: Schon mal den Witz über die Polizistin, die Blondine, die Psychopathin und die Mafia-Erbin gehört? Birds of Prey: The Emancipation of Harley Quinn ist eine ziemlich abgedrehte Geschichte, von Harley höchstpersönlich auf unnachahmliche Art erzählt. Als einer der schrecklichsten Schurken Gothams, Roman Sionis, und seine sadistische Rechte Hand, Zsasz, ein junges Mädchen namens Cass ins Visier nim...
overview.en: Harley Quinn, Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya battle Gotham crime boss Black Mask.

title.de: Blood - You Can't Bury the Truth
Bob Dylan: Leader of the Free World
title.en: Bob Dylan: Leader of the Free World

overview.en: Explore Bob Dylan's transformative journey through music, from folk poet to cultural icon, his impact on generations, and the timeless legacy of his lyrics, voice, and ever-evolving artistry.

title.de: Bridget Jones - Am Rande des Wahnsinns
title.en: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason

overview.en: Not that Bridget's counting, but it's been six wonderful weeks, four fabulous days and seven precious hours with one flawless boyfriend, Mark Darcy. But when mischievous and devilishly charming Daniel Cleaver arrives on the scene claiming to be a reformed man, can Bridget find a way to make true love last forever? There's nothing like love to send you over the edge!
A celebration of the life and career of one of Hollywood’s most beloved action heroes of his generation with more than 100 films under his belt.

title.de: Buenas noches, dijo la señorita Pájaro

overview.en: Un adulterio, un secreto de familia, un asesino en serie. Una historia hecha con la estructura de las muñecas rusas y al ritmo de las montañas rusas.

overview.de: Das große Finale der „Bull Shark"-Trilogie, in der eine gefährliche Bullenhai-Familie einer kleinen texanischen Gemeinde entgegen tritt.
overview.en: Los habitantes de un pequeño pueblo de Texas vuelven a enfrentar a una familia de tiburones toro que amenaza a su comunidad junto al lago.
A destination wedding at a cursed summer camp seemed like a good idea until the Bridezilla’s wedding planners started getting murdered, one by one.

overview.de: Zain (Zain Al Rafeea) ist gerade einmal zwölf Jahre alt. Zumindest wird er auf dieses Alter geschätzt. Der Junge hat keine Papiere und die Familie weiß auch nicht mehr genau, wann er geboren wurde. Nun steht er vor Gericht und verklagt seine Eltern, weil sie ihn auf die Welt gebracht haben, obwohl sie sich nicht um ihn kümmern können. Dem Richter schildert er seine bewegende Geschichte: Was passierte, nachdem er von zu Hause weggelaufen ist und bei einer jungen Mutter aus Äthiopien Unterschlupf fand und wie es dazu kam, dass er sich mit ihrem Baby mittellos und allein durch die Slums von Beirut kämpfen musste. Ein Kind klagt seine Eltern an und mit ihnen eine ganze Gesellschaft, die solche Geschichten zulässt. „Capernaum“ ist eine Beschreibung biblischen Ursprungs, die sich vor allem im Arabischen und Französischen als Bild für einen Ort voller Chaos und Unordnung etabliert hat. Einen solchen Ort zeigt die libanesische Regisseurin Nadine Labaki (CARAMEL) in ihrer hochemotionalen Fabel. In visuell eindrucksvollen Kinobildern erzählt CAPERNAUM – STADT DER HOFFNUNG von den abenteuerlichen Lebensumständen jener, die von einem besseren Leben träumen, aber in unserer Welt keine Chance haben. Mitreißend inszeniert legt Nadine Labaki die Mechanismen unglaublicher, sozialer Ungerechtigkeit offen und gibt denen eine Stimme, die im Schatten leben, oft ohne Ausweispapiere und Arbeitsmöglichkeiten. Ein Film von großer Empathie und Menschlichkeit.
overview.en: From acclaimed director Nadine Labaki ('Caramel', 'Where Do We Go Now?') comes a stunning new film that is quite simply unforgettable. In a courtroom a young boy named Zain (Zain Al Rafeea) stands before a judge. He asks to sue his own parents for giving him life. The turn of events that have brought him to this point take us on a journey through his poverty stricken upbringing in Beirut.

Carlos works at a car dealership. He thinks he knows everything there is to know about mechanics and football. He’s always having a few beers and cracking sexist and homophobic jokes. The purchase of a new wardrobe changes him and his routine. From then on, he becomes two different characters. During the day, he’s Carlos, the macho. At night, he turns into Carlitos, who’s kind, talented and fun.
Professional thief Mason attempts his biggest heist with his brother but when it goes wrong they're trapped inside. Tension rises as Mason negotiates with his ex-lover, the lead negotiator.
A father struggles to save his family from the hideous and deformed creature he finds living within the walls of the castle they've just inherited.
The birthday gift of a seemingly harmless AI-enhanced doll from a concerned mom to her lonely 13-year-old unleashes a two-foot-tall slashing spree.
Starring Natalie Lisinska. When interior designer Emily is hired by a foreign embassy to decorate for their holiday ball, ambassador Magnus Andersson's 'minimalist' approach creates a roadblock.

title.de: City under Fire - Die Bombe tickt

overview.en: A terrorist expert in explosives, whose gang has been dismantled, seeks revenge. He threatens to blow up a Hong Kong tunnel with hundreds of hostages. The policeman who has already beaten him once must stop him again.

Clean Job is the story of a grief stricken, broken young woman named Kimberly, who grows up to be the ruthless master mind behind a criminal syndicate of desperate, poor women from the township, who disguise themselves as domestic workers, to rob rich people living in the suburbs of Johannesburg.

Documentary exposing a historic crime spree in crypto, where hackers steal hundreds of millions and claim they've broken no laws. Told through cyber vigilantes tracking sophisticated attackers - including a teenage prodigy who stole $64M and became the first to test the 'code is law' defence before fleeing from justice.

A fairytale relationship comes to an end when a shy women suspects that her boyfriend is cheating on her. She follows him and sees him meeting up with another woman. Although devastated, she decides not to tell her boyfriend in order to learn more about his lies. But when she finds out the dark and deadly secret he's been hiding, her life turns into an endless nightmare.
This documentary explores telepathy, consciousness, and alien contact through the testimonies of those who have communicated with extraterrestrials.
Vanesa, durante su proceso de separación, plasma sus vivencias como pareja en un cortometraje para distanciarse y atravesar el duelo.

Cowspiracy: The Sustainability is a groundbreaking feature-length environmental documentary following an intrepid filmmaker as he uncovers the most destructive industry facing the planet today-and investigates why the world's leading environmental organizations are too afraid to talk about it.

overview.de: Unter der Führung von Rocky Balboa stellt sich der frischgebackene Meister im Halbschwergewicht, Adonis Creed, gegen Viktor Drago, den Sohn von Ivan Drago.
overview.en: Rocky Balboa trains boxing phenom Adonis Johnson for a showdown against the son of Ivan Drago.

overview.de: Nach dem Ende seiner siegreichen Boxkarriere führt Adonis Creed ein erfolgreiches Berufs- und Familienleben. Doch jetzt setzt er alles aufs Spiel, um gegen einen Kämpfer - und ehemaligen Freund - anzutreten, der absolut nichts zu verlieren hat.
overview.en: After dominating the boxing world, Adonis Creed has been thriving in his career and family life. But now he puts his future on the line to battle a fighter and former friend who has absolutely nothing to lose…and everything to gain.
A former rodeo star and washed-up horse breeder goes on a redemptive journey to Mexico to retrieve his ex-boss's son in this moving drama.
Julianne Hough (Safe Haven) stars as a bride-to-be who crashes her car to escape a psychopathic hitchhiker (Teddy Sears, Masters of Sex), uncovering a shocking truth.
A boy and his widowed stepmother find themselves in fear for their lives after they are visited by an unexplainable creature which appears to mimic the boy's recently deceased father.
Detective Jack Caine thought he’d taken on every kind of crime on Earth until someone—or something—starts using human bodies to manufacture narcotics.
When a strange mist enters an idyllic coastal town, causing ten local women to become mysteriously pregnant, they give birth to children who turn out to be mind-controlling demons.

30 years after accidentally being released from its ouija board prison by the son of a well-known exorcist, a demon escapes to roam the earth and terrorize all those who are responsible for its imprisonment. Can it once again be banished back to hell?
When his grandmother’s dies, a selfish man must change his ways or lose his inheritance but luckily, he is not alone on his journey to self-discovery.
An army ranger must stop a mercenary team who has seized an energy plant.
A chilling true story about the bizarre correspondence between an ambitious criminology student and convicted serial killer John Wayne Gacy.

Cheerleader Kelly is imprisoned and forced to take part in social media challenges at the behest of her seemingly motivated kidnapper. She soon finds that she's fighting for her life, as well as the lives of other young women.

overview.de: Seine Familie wurde von einem Dämon getötet und seine Schwester verflucht. Daher macht sich Tanjiro auf die gefährliche Suche nach einem Heilmittel.
overview.en: After a demon attack leaves his family slain and his sister cursed, Tanjiro embarks upon a perilous journey to find a cure and avenge those he's lost.
When two of her fellow cheerleaders go missing, a teen who believes the events may be connected to a curse launches her own investigation.
Centuries after a satanic group of knights were executed, they return to the woods as undead killers chasing down a father and daughter for revenge.

title.de: Der Hobbit - Die Schlacht der fünf Heere
title.en: The Hobbit: The Battle of the Five Armies

overview.de: Bilbo und sein Heer sind gezwungen, gegen eine Reihe von Kämpfern in die Schlacht zu ziehen, um zu verhindern, dass der Einsame Berg in die Hände einer aufkommenden Dunkelheit fällt.
overview.en: Men, Dwarves and Elves must unite or fall to the dual threats of Sauron's Orcs and Smaug the dragon.

overview.de: Ein Hobbit soll einigen Zwergen helfen, ihren Schatz aus den verlorenen Gebieten zurückzugewinnen.
overview.en: Hobbit Bilbo Baggins joins 13 dwarves on a quest to reclaim the lost kingdom of Erebor.

title.en: The Hobbit: The Desolation of Smaug

overview.de: The Hobbit Bilbo Baggins continues his adventure with Gandalf and Thorin Oakenshield, encountering the vicious dragon Smaug.
overview.en: Bilbo and his companions reach the Lonely Mountain, where they encounter the fearsome dragon Smaug.

A possessed Ninja doll teams up with a shy teenager to avenge the murder of a poor child factory worker. Alex learns courage enough to vanquish the school bully and score points with his school crush.
Jessica Alba stars as the lone survivor of a religious cult mass suicide who returns to the scene of the tragedy years later, with frightening results.

A young woman embarks on a remote hiking trail in the Alps to cope with a trauma. In the midst of the rustic landscape, she is now not only confronted with her own fears, but also has to face an alien threat. A fight for survival in the wilderness begins.
In his quest to create the ultimate virtual reality software, a computer scientist finds his perfect human guinea pig in a slow-witted gardener.
Built on the acclaimed travel series Departures, two knowledgeable and funny hosts guide astonishing adventures into the depths of the seven seas.

title.en: Detective Dee and the Cult of Heaven

title.de: Die Chroniken von Narnia: Die Reise auf der Morgenröte
title.en: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Voyage of the Dawn Treader

overview.de: Edmund und Lucy reisen noch einmal nach Narnia, um mit König Kaspian ein neues Abenteuer zu erleben. Teil 3 des effektstarken Märchens nach den Kinderbuchklassikern von C.S. Lewis.
overview.en: Lucy and Edmund are spending a dreary holiday with their cousin Eustace Clarence Scrubb, who is a rather dour and mean spirited little boy. They are unexpectedly drawn into Narnia when a painting of a ship on the wall of Lucy's room comes to life, and the three children fall into the ocean to be rescued by the Dawn Treader.

Each year on Halloween just before the harvest, the teenagers in a small farming community band together to try to stop Sawtooth Jack, a demon who rises from the cornfields and races to the town church killing anyone who gets in his way.
When two actors star in a movie about a love affair in nineteenth-century England, their off-screen life starts to resemble the film’s plot.

When lifestyle writer and committed bachelorette Hannah Monroe inherits her late-grandmother's cabin, she hires her widowed neighbour, local handyman, Cole, to help get it in shape to sell. But as Hannah and Cole spend time together, Hannah can't help but feel her faith in love and relationships being restored- and she questions whether or not she should sell the cabin at all.

title.de: Die Pfefferkörner und der Fluch des schwarzen Königs
title.en: The Peppercorns and the Curse of the Black King

overview.en: The peppercorns embark on a risky mission - including creepy mountain ghosts.
After receiving a ninjutsu death threat, a businessman enlists a kendo teacher trained in the art of the ninja to catch the would-be assassin.
Colorado teens fight back after Soviet-led paratroops drop into town for World War III.

Recently divorced Jaclyn desperately wants to become a mom – by any means necessary.  She enlists her best friends to help pull off the ultimate sperm heist on unsuspecting "donors" during her friend’s intimate birthday party!
Plans for a quiet Thanksgiving between two girlfriends go up in smoke when their party is crashed by a comically chaotic group of their loved ones.

title.de: Don't Look Back - Schatten der Vergangenheit

overview.en: A beautiful, best-selling author loses her grip as she slowly morphs into the body of another woman, in this tense psychological thriller.
On the 20th anniversary of the grisly Christmas Eve murders at St. Agnes Church, a demonic priest from the past returns to haunt the town's residents.

title.de: DOWN TO EARTH - Die Hüter der Erde

overview.en: Leaving behind their cosmopolitan life, a couple and their three young children travel the ends of the earth searching for a new perspective on life. In their five-year journey across six continents, they live with some of the oldest indigenous communities on the planet.

title.de: Drink: A Look Inside the Glass
title.en: Drink: A Look Inside the Glass

overview.en: An epic adventure into the domains of the world’s eminent alcohol producers with a narrowed focus on the history, process and craft of a single drink.
Ce documentaire captivant mettra au défi votre façon de voir l'industrie alimentaire. Quel est le vrai coût de la nourriture? Qui paie le prix?

Edith: Porsche's Volcano Ascent follows Porsche engineers on a quest to set a world altitude record on Chile's Ojos del Salado, the highest active volcano. In a modified 911, the team faces extreme elements and secrecy over three attempts.
The lives of two families change forever after a fatal tragedy takes place on Reservation Road.

title.en: It's a Mad, Mad, Mad, Mad World

overview.en: When a dying ex-con drops a clue as to where he buried $350,000 in stolen cash, the five people who witness his death make a mad race for the money.

title.de: Endless Sunshine on a Cloudy Day
title.en: Endless Sunshine on a Cloudy Day

overview.en: Jade McCann, an enigmatic and multi-talented Irish influencer, is diagnosed with terminal cancer only 3 weeks after her father, Anthony. Bringing the family's struggles into the public domain, Jade's social media presence generates both community and alienation. Does social media provide a lasting legacy, or a delusion of belonging in a world of empty connections?
Ex-criminal Jacob Sternwood is forced to return to London from his Icelandic hideaway.

title.de: English Babu Desi Mem - Der Junge aus England und das indische Mädchen

overview.en: After his brother dies, wealthy Vikram reluctantly returns to India and forms a surprise bond with his orphaned nephew and the showgirl raising him.

title.de: Escape from the Deep - Bis zum letzten Atemzug

overview.en: A British diver's lifelong search for a WWII shipwreck leads to a life-and-death dive with him and his group of old college friends. Trapped in the dark depths, they are forced to confront their own limits and fears before time runs out.

Jenifa must navigate through jealousy and suspicion when her philanthropy position is threatened by her new neighbour in the estate. A trip to Ghana with friends turns dangerous when they are caught up in a drug scandal, forcing Jenifa to confront betrayal and danger, risking everything to protect her reputation and life.
The remaining survivors of a global pandemic face a race against time to find a cure before they succumb to the virus’s zombie-inducing effects.

overview.de: Für die besten Freundinnen Becky und Hunter geht es im Leben vor allem darum, Ängste zu überwinden und an ihre Grenzen zu gehen. Aber nachdem sie 600 Meter auf die Spitze eines abgelegenen, verlassenen Funkturms geklettert sind, finden sie sich plötzlich ohne Ausweg nach unten wieder. Die Kletterfähigkeiten und das Durchhaltevermögen der beiden Freundinnen werden auf eine harte Probe gestellt, denn sie kämpfen verzweifelt darum, in schwindelerregender Höhe am Leben zu bleiben, um einen Ausweg zu finden...
overview.en: For best friends Becky and Hunter, life is all about conquering fears and pushing limits. However, after they climb 2,000 feet to the top of a remote, abandoned radio tower, they find themselves stranded with no way down. Now, their expert climbing skills are put to the ultimate test as they desperately fight to survive the elements, a lack of supplies, and vertigo-inducing heights.

overview.de: Martin Freeman, Kirsten Dunst, Carrie Coon, Chris Rock und Juno Temple spielen abwechselnd die Hauptrollen in dieser Anthologie bizarrer Verbrechen.
overview.en: In this anthology series inspired by the 1996 film, each season follows a mostly new cast of characters who get involved with murder investigations in different Midwestern towns, with seemingly unrelated crimes sometimes being connected in some way.
Faced with losing his grip on the Hong Kong underworld, a Triad leader resorts to extreme violence to regain his status and the respect of his triad.

title.de: Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas
title.en: Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas

overview.de: Während von der Aufbruchstimmung der 60er Jahre nur Marihuana-Rauchschwaden übrig geblieben sind, erhält Journalist und Connaisseur jeder erdenklichen Droge Raoul Duke (Johnny Depp) den Auftrag, über das Mint 400 Rennen in Las Vegas zu berichten.
overview.en: Oscar nominee Johnny Depp and Benicio Del Toro star in Hunter S. Thompson's classic psychedelic story of two friends, a suitcase full of pharmaceuticals and the ultimate "trip" to Sin City.
When a group of home invaders attacks her sister’s bachelorette party, military veteran Tess leads her fellow women in a fight for survival.
In this explosive action thriller, two crime lords battle to rule the underworld, and a hit man with his own problems plots his rise to power.
When it comes to serial killers, there aren't many stories more chilling than the one involving a couple that raped, tortured and murdered together.
When a black market arms deal goes wrong, Justine is caught in the crossfire and forced to navigate a warehouse full of trigger-happy madmen.

overview.de: Bateman und McAdams spielen Max und Annie, deren wöchentlicher Pärchen-Spieleabend todernst wird, als Max' Bruder (Chandler) eine Krimi-Party plant, die sich als echt herausstellt.
overview.en: Bateman & McAdams star as Max & Annie, whose weekly couples Game Night gets kicked up a notch when Max's brother (Chandler) plans a murder mystery party that turns out to be real.
Two men face the consequences after they kill a man and pin the murder on an innocent transient.
Starring Mira Sorvino. Veronica is a politician's wife whose brief affair with a troubled young artist comes back to haunt her when he begins to infiltrate every part of her life.
A former Australian intelligence officer living a quiet suburban life is pulled back into action when her daughter doesn’t return from a camping trip.

overview.de: In diesem spektakulären Abenteuer muss Godzilla, das weltberühmte Monster, gegen zwei Kreaturen antreten, die entstanden durch wissenschaftliche Arroganz, die gesamte Menschheit bedrohen.
overview.en: With ancient monsters reawakening, humanity faces a global threat. Bryan Cranston and Aaron Taylor-Johnson lead the fight for survival in this visually stunning reboot, where chaos reveals an unexpected ally.

title.de: Godzilla II: King of the Monsters

overview.de: Als die titanischen Monster sich erheben, muss sich das kryptozoologische Monarch Institut Godzilla, Mothra, Rodan und King Ghidorah bei deren Kampf um die Vorherrschaft stellen.
overview.en: When ancient god-sized monsters rise again, the crypto-zoological agency Monarch faces off against Godzilla, Mothra, Rodan, and King Ghidorah as they all vie for supremacy.

overview.de: Kampf der Giganten: Die Riesenechse und der Monsteraffe treffen in dem Blockbuster zum spektakulären Duell aufeinander - bei dem das Schicksal der ganzen Welt auf dem Spiel steht.
overview.en: Legends collide as Godzilla and Kong, the two most powerful forces of nature, clash in a spectacular battle for the ages. As Monarch embarks on a perilous mission into fantastic uncharted terrain, unearthing clues to the Titans’ very origins, a human conspiracy threatens to wipe the creatures, both good and bad, from the face of the earth forever.

title.de: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
title.en: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire

overview.de: In diesem neuen Abenteuer treten Kong und Godzilla gegen eine kolossale Bedrohung an, die in unserer Welt verborgen liegt und ihre Existenz - und die der Menschheit - in Frage stellt.
overview.en: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet.
Specially trained to assist her, a quadriplegic woman’s Belgian Shepherd support dog contracts a strange disease and turns into her worst enemy.

overview.de: Das 15. Jahrhundert. In einer abgeschiedenen Berghütte lebt die junge Ziegenhirtin Albrun mit ihrer Mutter. Als diese stirbt ist Albrun auf sich allein gestellt und wird als junge Frau von der Dorfgemeinschaft als Hexe abgestempelt. Nun ist sie gezwungen gegen alle Widrigkeiten anzukämpfen.
overview.en: A psychedelic horror trip about a woman who discovers evidence of a 15th century woman whose tortured life spawned a supernatural curse on humanity.

title.de: Halloween IV - Michael Myers kehrt zurück
title.en: Halloween 4: The Return of Michael Myers

overview.en: Ten years ago, he changed the face of Halloween. Tonight, he's back. Following the bold detour of Halloween III: Season of the Witch, producer Moustapha Akkhad was keen to bring the series back to its roots, resurrecting the iconic figure of Michael Myers to terrorise a fresh cast of defenceless victims. Helmed by director Dwight H.

title.de: Halloween V - Die Rache des Michael Myers
title.en: Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers

overview.en: Michael lives - and this time they're ready! Director Dominique Othenin-Girard's Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers takes the series into ever more twisted territory, blending slasher carnage with supernatural undertones and expanding the mythos that would haunt the franchise for years to come.
UNSC Cadet Thomas Lasky must conquer his inner fears and join forces with super-soldier John-117 to take down a massive faction of the Covenant.
The universe of the Halo video game series is expanded in seven short animated films from Japan's greatest anime directors and studios.
An unstable war veteran with a savior complex receives a shocking wake-up call upon returning stateside and accepting a position in Homeland Security.

The national ski jumping team of China is trained in Finland, starting from scratch just three years before the Beijing Winter Olympics. Under the guidance of legendary coach Mika Kojonkoski, young athletes strive to represent their country on the world stage. The team becomes a family and the pursuit of joy ultimately becomes the most important factor in their development.
A family moves into a mansion, one of the most haunted places in America, where a malevolent force abducts their daughter.
A reclusive immortal who needs human flesh but tries to stay clean finds himself cast back into society by a gang of thugs and his estranged daughter.

A shy high-schooler, Naomi, meets a mysterious man who claims to be his future self. This future Naomi tells him that he will fall in love with his classmate Ruri, and that Ruri will be killed in a subsequent accident. Naomi struggles to change the future in order to save Ruri’s life, as he learns Naomi’s true purpose and the secrets of his world.
After a castle-turned-hotel owner rebrands his lodging as a haunted tourist attraction, real phantoms show up, and they're not happy.

title.de: Home Office: Un especial de Mirreyes contra Godínez
title.en: Home Office: Un especial de Mirreyes contra Godínez

overview.en: The pandemic has been hard for everyone and Mirreyes and Godinez are learning to live in confinement. Months of the new normal have not been enough for it to stop being new or become normal. Kuri González Shoe Stores employees no longer have control of their quarantine and recovering a shoe shipment in customs will be harder than ever when the whole team is on the edge of a nervous breakdown.

overview.de: Der verwitwete Ex-Agent Phil zieht mit seiner Tochter in eine Kleinstadt. Doch das ruhige Leben ist nur von kurzer Dauer, als der ansässige Drogenboss seinen Weg kreuzt.
overview.en: Tras la muerte de su esposa, un exagente de la DEA se muda con su hija a la Luisiana rural, donde enfrenta a un despiadado narcotraficante local.
Pulse-pounding music and awesome dance moves ignite this exhilarating story of one dancer’s (Jessica Alba) passion, determination and finding the courage to follow your dreams.

overview.de: Elefant Horton (Stimme: Christoph Maria Herbst) hört den Hilferuf eines Staubkorns. Auf dem befindet sich ein Mikrokosmos namens Huheim, dessen Bürgermeister sich Sorgen macht um den Untergang der klitzekleinen Welt. Zu Recht: Das biestige Känguru (Stimme: Anke Engelke) und Adler Vlad wollen das Staubkorn vernichten. Doch sie haben die Rechnung ohne Horton gemacht. Der will die Hus retten. Und er ist ein Elefant, der hält, was er verspricht. - Elefantastischer Animationsspaß von den "Ice Age"-Machern.
overview.en: Horton the Elephant struggles to protect a microscopic community from his neighbors who refuse to believe it exists.
A sheriff discovers that his siblings kidnap their motel guests and then grind up their flesh in order to make their famous sausages.

overview.de: Ridley Scott erzählt das Schicksal der berühmten Mode-Dynastie: Patrizia (Lady Gaga) heiratet den Gucci-Spross Maurizio (Adam Driver). Ihre Geltungssucht reißt die Familie in den Abgrund.
overview.en: An outsider from humble beginnings with unbridled ambition marries into a fashion dynasty and triggers a spiral of decadence, revenge and murder.
On Halloween night, four teens find a haunted house that rewards visitors for every floor completed and soon learn why no one’s made it to the end.

overview.de: Eine Gruppe junger Erwachsener navigiert in New York durch ein Geflecht aus Liebe und Beziehungen.
overview.en: Alice, Robin, Lucy, Meg, Tom and David all have in common is the need to learn how to be single in a world filled with ever-evolving definitions of love.
These heartwarming stories explore the abiding emotional bonds that form between dogs and their caregivers, no matter the circumstances.
A humble widower and single dad who makes his living by disappearing bodies runs afoul of his gangster boss when his latest job turns out to be alive.

This raw, powerful documentary takes the viewer right into the incredible world of brave sailor and solo adventurer Lisa Blair as she embarks on her voyage to be the first woman to sail solo, non-stop, and unassisted around Antarctica.

title.de: Ideal Home - Ein Vater kommt selten allein

overview.en: A bickering gay couple’s self-indulgent lifestyle is turned upside-down, when the 10-year-old grandson they never knew existed crashes their party.
Thieves attempt a massive heist against the US Treasury, but the Category 5 hurricane approaching one of its mint facilities was not part of the plan.
About a Vietnam vet/New York City cop who fights his own private war against underground crime and violence in Chinatown.
A young American doctor travels to a remote village in Colombia to assess a boy that the villagers claim is the work of the devil.

A journey of soul searching, science, nature and creativity. 'Innsaei: The Power of Intuition' takes us on a global journey to uncover the art of connecting within in today's world of distraction and stress. The world is changing faster than ever before and new ways of thinking are required. How is this affecting the way we live our lives?
A lone man traverses a post-apocalyptic city engulfed in constant darkness. As he flees from danger, his very existence will be put to the test.

An intimate portrait of mothers, daughters and intergenerational trauma, Jacinta follows a woman in and out of prison as she attempts to break free from an inherited cycle of addiction and incarceration. We begin at the correctional center where Jacinta and her mother Rosemary are confined, both recovering from addiction. On release, Jacinta hopes to reconnect with her own young daughter.
A homicide detective believes she's on the trail of an infamous serial killer and is forced to work with her ex husband on the case.

overview.de: Ausgestattet mit der Lizenz zum Töten bricht Geheimagent James Bond zu seiner ersten Mission als 007 auf. Er muss einen Waffenhändler in einem Pokerspiel mit hohem Einsatz im Casino Royale besiegen, aber es ist nichts wie es scheint.
overview.en: Based on Ian Fleming's first 007 novel, James Bond (Daniel Craig) must thwart a dangerous Russian spy who is funding global terrorists from winning a poker game worth millions. The 21st film in the most successful film series in cinematic history.

title.de: James Bond 007 - Der Hauch des Todes

overview.de: KGB-General Georgi Koskov hat dem britischen Geheimdienst avisiert, daß er in den Westen überlaufen will. James Bond 007, nach einer spektakulären Übung auf Gibraltar in Hochform, befördert ihn von Bratislava durch eine Pipeline nach Österreich und macht anschließend nähere Bekanntschaft mit der schönen Cellistin Kara Milovy, die bei Koskovs Flucht eine etwas undurchsichtige Rolle spielte.
overview.en: Timothy Dalton is suave, cunning and lethal in his debut film as James Bond in this turbo-charged action-adventure that sees Agent 007 battling diabolical arms merchants who are united in a terrifying conspiracy for world domination!

title.de: James Bond 007 - Der Mann mit dem goldenen Colt
title.en: The Man with the Golden Gun

overview.de: Im neunten James-Bond-Film kämpft Roger Moore als 007 gegen Christopher Lee, der als Dracula-Darsteller bekannt wurde James Bond, Geheimagent Ihrer Majestät, sieht sich von dem berüchtigten Killer Scaramanga herausgefordert.
overview.en: James Bond (Roger Moore) has been marked for death, and he'll need all his lethal instincts to survive in this action-packed adventure as he faces off in a deadly game of cat-and-mouse with renowned assassin Francisco Scaramanga (Christopher Lee).

title.de: James Bond 007 - Der Morgen stirbt nie

overview.de: Ein britischer Flugzeugträger wird durch chinesische Kampfjets versenkt. Der Geheimagent James Bond hat 48 Stunden, um einen Krieg zu verhindern. Rasch kommt er dem skrupellosen Hamburger Medien-Magnaten Carver auf die Spur. Der löste die Krise aus, um mit seinem Satelliten-TV den Asienmarkt zu erobern.
overview.en: For a deranged media tycoon (Jonathan Pryce), ratings are everything…even if it means global destruction. Now, 007 (Pierce Brosnan) must take on this evil mastermind in an adrenaline-charged battle to end his reign of terror! Judi Dench also stars.

overview.de: Sean Connerys letzter offizieller Auftritt als 007: James Bond jagt seinen Erzfeind Blofeld, der die Welt mit einem riesigen Laser bedroht.
overview.en: A fortune in stolen diamonds thrust James Bond (Sean Connery) back into action in this thrilling adventure when his evil nemesis Blofeld (Charles Gray) plans to unleash a deadly laser satellite…and the fate of the world hangs in the balance.

title.de: James Bond 007 - Die Welt ist nicht genug

overview.de: Als der einflussreiche Öl-Magnat Sir Robert King bei einem brutalen Selbstmordanschlag getötet wird, erhält James Bond den Auftrag, für den Schutz von dessen Tochter und Alleinerbin Elektra zu sorgen. Offenbar steckt der russische Terrorist Renard hinter dem Attentat.
overview.en: Bond takes position as bodyguard of a British oil tycoon's daughter after a deadly mishap at MI6.

overview.de: Nachdem er von Vesper, der Frau, die er geliebt hat, betrogen wurde, macht sich James Bond auf die Suche nach den Drahtziehern hinter ihrer Ermordung. Bond stößt schon bald auf den gleichermaßen angesehenen wie gefährlichen Umweltschützer Dominic Greene. Mit einem mächtigen Unternehmen namens Quantum im Rücken, scheint Greene auch weniger ehrenhafte Ziele zu verfolgen.
overview.en: Seeking vengeance for his lover's death, James Bond uncovers a conspiracy to take control of a country's most precious natural resource.

overview.de: Sean Connery trifft als James Bond auf den Schurken Goldfinger (Gert Fröbe). Der plant, die Goldreserven von Fort Knox atomar zu verseuchen.
overview.en: Goldfinger is stockpiling gold reserves. Bond investigates, and uncovers an audacious plan to commit the heist of the century.

title.de: James Bond 007 - Im Angesicht des Todes

overview.de: Roger Moores Abschieds-Bond: 007 kämpft gegen den Tech-Schurken Zorin (Christopher Walken) und dessen gefährliche Helferin (Grace Jones).
overview.en: Secret agent 007 must stop a megalomaniacal technology mogul from destroying Silicon Valley in this last appearance by Roger Moore as James Bond. Computer baron Max Zorin (Christopher Walken) is planning to trigger a major California earthquake in order to wipe out his competitors. Bond is assigned to stop him, but first he must do battle with Zorin's statuesque partner in crime, May Day (Grace Jones). High-wire confrontations ensue, as Bond battles the villains at international landmarks like the Eiffel Tower and romances an attractive geologist.

overview.de: 007 (Roger Moore) muss in der Ägäis das Computersystem eines britischen Spionageschiffs bergen, bevor es in die Hände der Sowjets fällt.
overview.en: In the race to beat the Russians to a missing communications device Bond finds himself involved with the Greek underworld.

title.de: James Bond 007 - Keine Zeit zu sterben

overview.de: Die gefährliche Mission zur Rettung eines entführten Wissenschaftlers führt Bond auf die Spur eines mysteriösen Gegenspielers, der im Besitz neuster Waffentechnik ist.
overview.en: A mission to rescue a kidnapped scientist turns out to be far more treacherous than expected, leading Bond (Daniel Craig) onto the trail of a mysterious villain armed with dangerous new technology.

overview.de: Timothy Daltons zweiter und letzter Bond-Einsatz: 007 jagt auf eigene Faust einen Drogenboss, der die Frau seines Freundes ermordet hat.
overview.en: Shortly after an important drugs bust, CIA Agent Felix Leiter is married, but when the drug lord he arrested escapes, kills his wife and mutilates Leiter his old friend British Agent James Bond seeks revenge. When "M" orders 007 to drop the matter and start a new assignment, Bond deserts her Majesty's Secret Service and embarks on a world wide personal vendetta to kill those responsible.

title.de: James Bond 007 - Man lebt nur zweimal

overview.de: Als amerikanische und russische Raumschiffe auf ungewöhnliche Weise gekapert werden, verdächtigen Washington und Moskau sich gegenseitig. Der britische Geheimdienst glaubt, es besser zu wissen, und so kommt Agent 007 alias James Bond (Sean Connery) zu einem neuen brisanten Auftrag. Angesichts so viel Bosheit kann die Welt von Glück sagen, dass James Bond auch mit Burschen wie Blofeld fertig wird.
overview.en: In this magnificent, pull-out-all-the-stops movie spectacular, Bond (Sean Connery) travels all the way to Japan, racing to prevent the evil SPECTRE organization and its diabolical leader, Blofeld (Donald Pleasence), from starting World War III!

overview.de: Roger Moore in Space: James Bond kämpft im All gegen einen Superschurken, der die Menschheit vernichten und die Erde neu bevölkern will.
overview.en: British agent James Bond investigates the disappearance of an Anglo-American space shuttle, which has fallen into the hands of a billionaire megalomaniac intent on world domination. Along the way, Bond has to contend with giant, steel-toothed hit man Jaws, before stowing away on a flight to a space station being used as a colony to breed a genetically `pure' race.

overview.de: Bond im geteilten Deutschland: 007 (Roger Moore) muss einen Sowjet-General aufhalten, der in der Bundesrepublik eine Atombombe zünden will.
overview.en: Roger Moore returns as the suave James Bond in this electrifying adventure! Lured to the Indian palace of the enigmatic Octopussy (Maud Adams), 007 learns of a plot by the diabolical villain Kamal Khan (Louis Jourdan) that could destroy the world

overview.de: Eine mysteriöse Nachricht aus Bonds Vergangenheit setzt ihn auf die Fährte einer zwielichtigen Organisation, die er aufzudecken versucht. Während M damit beschäftigt ist, politische Mächte zu bekämpfen, um den Secret Service am Leben zu erhalten, kann Bond eine Täuschung nach der anderen ans Licht bringen, um die schreckliche Wahrheit zu enthüllen, die sich hinter SPECTRE verbirgt.
overview.en: A cryptic message from Bond's past sends him on a trail to uncover a sinister organization. While M battles political forces to keep the secret service alive, Bond peels back the layers of deceit to reveal the terrible truth behind SPECTRE.

title.de: James Bond 007 - Stirb an einem anderen Tag

overview.de: Pierce Brosnans letzter Bond-Auftritt, mit Halle Berry und Rosamund Pike: 007 jagt einen Bösewicht, der den 3. Weltkrieg anzetteln will.
overview.en: James Bond teams up with a female American agent to track down a North Korean businessman bent on world domination.

Mezu discovers he's trapped in a time loop in Nigeria. To his surprise, his colleague Kamsi is in the same predicament. Together with friends Tobe, Wasiu, and Sola, they unite to break free from the time loop.

title.de: Jennifer's Body - Jungs nach ihrem Geschmack

overview.de: Als eine beliebte Teenagerin unstillbaren Appetit auf Highschool-Jungs bekommt, versuchen die besten Freund*innen, ihre blutigen Gelüste unter Kontrolle zu halten.
overview.en: Megan Fox is a luscious teen temptress whose night out with an occult-obsessed rock band leaves her beaten, bruised and lusting for blood.

title.de: Jessy - Die Treppe in den Tod

overview.en: Sorority sisters are as good as dead when they're stalked by a psychopathic stranger over the Christmas holiday in this influential slasher.

overview.de: Bleigeladenes Actiongewitter: Als ehemaliger Killer der russischen Mafia kehrt Keanu Reeves in den New Yorker Untergrund zurück und schwört erbarmungslose Rache. - Früher war John Wick (Keanu Reeves) der berüchtigtste Killer der russischen Mafia in New York. Nach dem Tod seiner Frau lebt er zurückgezogen in einer Luxusvilla. Als eines Nachts der Sohn seines ehemaligen Chefs Viggo Tarasov (Michael Nyqvist) seinen Hund tötet und Wick selbst schwer verletzt, erwacht in ihm erneut der Killerinstinkt. Ausgestattet mit einem riesigen Waffenarsenal sinnt John auf Vergeltung.
overview.en: A legendary hit man comes out of retirement to go on a ruthless rampage of revenge against the sadistic punks who attacked him.
Tapashi returns to her countryside home to live a self-determined life after her higher education, but her family has already decided her destiny, from which no escape is possible!

title.de: Journey to the End of the Night
title.en: Journey to the End of the Night

overview.en: Six months after a surprise EMP attack, two newly drafted soldiers and a civilian journey to a nuclear missile silo to save the world from enemy drone technology hidden in food that infects and turns people into homicidal monsters called shriekers.

Devagiri is a remote village in the Karnataka - Tamilnadu border, their major concern is the lack of street lights on the main road that connects the village to the town, and that road is considered to be haunted after dusk. Simultaneously, a group of YouTubers, famous for their ghost-hunting videos are looking for their next adventure. Will they succeed in their endeavour?

RiffTrax, the guys who make movies funny, bring their comedic riffing treatment to this cheesy 80's Jean-Claude Van Damme Martial Arts classic!  This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from RiffTrax (former stars of Mystery Science Theater 3000).

Kobe Bryant, one of the greatest basketball players in history, grew up on the basketball courts of the Italian province, amidst pasta, small town life and passion for football. A unique fairytale: the story of the young Black Mamba, the teenager who conquered Italian basketball and was enchanted by our country.

title.de: Kubo Won't Let Me Be Invisible
title.en: Kubo Won't Let Me Be Invisible

overview.en: Junta has one goal: to experience youth to the fullest! Too bad Junta is socially invisible — but that changes when he meets Kubo. Her constant teasing is sure to turn Junta’s quiet life upside down, because Kubo won’t let him be invisible!
After a martial arts instructor kills a man by mistake, he is imprisoned, until the police need his help taking down a vengeful killer.
Three dancers in the world-renowned Paris Opera attempt to reconcile their personal struggles and prove their worth.

With thrilling access to flashpoints across the USA, UK, Europe and Brazil, this gripping investigation traces the global rise of far-right extremism - a threat long underestimated and now amplified by populist leaders and radical movements. How can democratic societies confront and counter a networked ideology that is increasingly organised, emboldened and transnational?
Six women come out of the shadows of the cannabis underground and risk everything to succeed in the newly legal market.

title.de: Lady Gaga: The Monster Ball Tour at Madison Square Garden
title.en: Lady Gaga Presents: The Monster Ball Tour at Madison Square Garden

overview.en: In February, 2011, Lady Gaga brought a band and dancers to Madison Square Garden, about 20 blocks from where she grew up. She sings, plays keyboards, dances, and talks - sometimes autobiographically - emphasizing possibilities, personal acceptance, and tolerance on the way to the Monster Ball, the greatest party in the world. The cameras catch her up close, in ensemble, and beneath the stage ch...
Following the murder of a billionare financer, his company desperately searches for his only heir, an adopted son who is pursued by assassins.

title.de: Last Hitman - 24 Stunden in der Hölle

overview.en: When 19-year-old Adam agrees to do a day's driving for his mum's gangster boyfriend Peter, it takes him on a 24-hour journey into a nightmarish world of murder, sex trafficking and revenge, in the company of aging hit man Roy.

Through a succession of images of the planet seen from the sky, Legacy is an ode to the beauty of nature and humanity. The film also sounds like a warning. Life on Earth has never been so threatened. If it is not too late to act, it is now.
When a troubled young woman becomes entangled with a mysterious new neighbor who resembles her dead mother, her fragile world spins out of control.

title.de: Lobito Bound: A Journey to Africa's New Frontier
title.en: Lobito Bound: A Journey to Africa's New Frontier

overview.en: Join British Jamaican explorer Dwayne Fields on an epic journey along Africa's Lobito Corridor, a new economic highway backed by Western powers to challenge China's dominance. As the U.S. scrambles to secure critical minerals and counter Beijing's influence, the film asks: will this project benefit Africa, or is it just a new battleground in the global superpower rivalry?
Join a team of elephant rescuers in a daring, 480-mile mission across Thailand to save elephant Noi Na from a trekking camp and bring her to freedom.
The British Royal Air Force takes to the skies to fend off Nazi invaders in this film inspired by the true events of the greatest air battle of WWII.
Follows the hilarious and heartwarming journey of the perfect boy next door who is determined to win the heart of a girl outside his economic league.
A remarkable portrait of journalist Lyra Mckee - murdered in Northern Ireland in 2019

An internationally recognised fashion icon, Carine Roitfeld's signature style has propelled her to goddess stature in the fashion world. Having recently turned in her crown as editor-in-chief of French Vogue, she's ready to embark on a new project: her very own signature fashion publication, CR Fashion Book.

Through the voice of Alessandro, the docufilm tells the story of how he became Mahmood. From his launch at Sanremo to being a global superstar. An intimate film made up of solitary moments, important relationships and huge crowds. An inner journey with music at its core and where love and absence manage to coexist.

overview.de: Have the time of your life with Meryl Streep and an all-star cast in this undeniably fun celebration of mothers and daughters, old friends and newly found family!
overview.en: A bride secretly invites three men from her mother's (Meryl Streep) past to come to the wedding.
In this documentary, a psychologist investigates her mother's past as a Holocaust survivor and uncovers a family secret that reshapes her identity.

When two women think they've fallen for the man of their dreams they will soon realize his charm was only a mask. Without realizing it, they get roped into an abusive cycle where what once started off so perfect will force them to make a hard choice between staying with the man they love or find a way to take their life back.
After magically waking up in her miniature holiday village, a woman whose childhood made her a Christmas control freak finally learns to let go.
An assassin-for-hire finds that he's become a target after he refuses to complete a job for a dangerous criminal organisation.

A young Canadian man sacrifices nearly everything in his determination to resurrect the King of Pop. Through gruelling training, radical cosmetic surgeries and unwavering dedication, 25-year-old Freddy Dufour transforms himself to resemble Michael Jackson. He seeks investors for a Las Vegas tribute show, increasingly blurring dreams and reality in his relentless quest for perfection.

Young activist Chris Huriwai takes on the giants of New Zealand's dairy industry. His journey uncovers alarming information about the industry's impact on the environment and our health, showing that we're on the edge of the biggest global disruption of food and agriculture in history. An international story told with a local eye, the film also points to what we can all do to change our fate.
A teen living an empty life of privilege with a neglectful boozy mom fills the void by hooking up with an escort agency where her stepdad is a client.

overview.de: Eine verklemmte und penible Polizistin (Reese Whiterspoon) versucht, die heiße und temperamentvolle Witwe (Sofia Vergara) eines Drogenbosses zu beschützen, während sie quer durch Texas vor korrupten Polizisten und Gangstern flüchten.
overview.en: An uptight and by-the-book cop tries to protect the widow of a drug boss.
A struggling family man robs a pill mill, but after the theft turns violent he is hunted by both the police and the Dixieland Mafia.
A loyal mobster is released after a long prison sentence only to discover that the crime family he has devoted his life to wants him dead.
A look at the life-changing connection between a retired and widowed American philosophy professor and a young Parisian woman.
A scientist becomes maniacally competitive when his brother discovers the skeletal remains of a prehistoric man who winds up ravaging the countryside.
A man consults a psychiatrist for help after he begins suffering an unrelenting series of terrifying flashbacks.

This romantic comedy is a tale of two strangers who believe in love, but seem to never be able to find its true meaning. In a wild twist of events, fate puts each in the other's path one stormy New Year's Eve, and comedy and chaos ensue.

overview.de: Bist du Player oder Watcher? Auf Vees (Emma Roberts) Highschool gibt es so gut wie kein anderes Gesprächsthema mehr als die immer riskanter werdenden Challenges, die das illegale Online-Game "Nerve" seinen Spielern stellt. Um einmal so wie ihre Freundin Sydney im Mittelpunkt zu stehen meldet sich die eher schüchterne Vee kurzentschlossen selbst bei "Nerve" an. Angetrieben vom Kick des Verbotenen bricht Vee mit ihrem ebenso attraktiven wie mysteriösen neuen Game-Partner Ian (Dave Franco) schnell alle Tabus: keine Challenge ist ihnen zu riskant. Über Nacht werden Vee und Ian die Sensation des immer gefährlicher werdenden Spiels! Doch als Vee herausfindet, dass ihre gesamten Social Media Accounts gehackt wurden, und versucht, aus dem Spiel wieder auszusteigen, muss sie feststellen, dass es dafür längst zu spät ist.
overview.en: Partnered with a sly and charming competitor (Dave Franco), a high school senior (Emma Roberts) plays a popular online game of dare that starts to take a sinister turn.
Stingy François Guatier's problems begin to mount when a 16-year-old girl shows up claiming to be his daughter.
On a Saturday night in Berlin a group of friends go out to have fun and enjoy themselves. Meanwhile, others are also out exploring the city and their relationships.

Niko is a flying reindeer boy whose biggest dream is to become a member of Santa's flying forces. But instead he loses Santa's sleigh and during pursuit to get it back he learns the importance of friendship and doing things your own way.

A love story spanning two continents, NOWHERE IN AFRICA is the extraordinary true tale of a Jewish family who flees the Nazi regime in 1938 for a remote farm in Kenya. Abandoning their once-comfortable existence in Germany, Walter Redlich, his wife Jettel and their five-year-old daughter Regina each deal with the harsh realities of their new life in different ways

A deep dive into the fiery intersection of free speech and hate speech, spotlighting the contentious actions of SIAN, an Islam-critical group whose incendiary protests incite fierce debates and necessitate extensive police protection. The film follows SIAN's leader, Lars Thorsen, and his associate, Fanny Bråten, alongside the endeavors of anti-racist activist Axel and his allies.

Massive protests erupted in Serbia over plans to build the largest lithium mine in Europe. Intrigued, environmental scientist Peter Tom Jones travels to Serbia's Jadar Valley, investigating the role of mining corporation Rio Tinto. This controversial doc investigates local and national protests, the metals we need to fight climate change, and disinformation.
An October 2015 viral video of a white cop assaulting a Black student at a South Carolina school creates a national firestorm and a demand for change.

title.de: Once Upon a Time - Es war einmal ...

overview.de: Epischer Mix aus Action-, Drama- und Märchenmotiven: Ein Junge und dessen Mutter kämpfen darum, mit einem Fluch belegte Märchenfiguren zu befreien.
overview.en: From the inventive minds of Lost executive producers Adam Horowitz and Edward Kitsis comes a bold new imagining of the world, where fairy tales and the modern day are about to collide.

Hunting whales is a matter of life or death for the Indigenous people of St. Lawrence, a tiny island in the Bering Sea. So, when Chris Apassingok becomes the youngest person to ever harpoon a whale for his village, his mother proudly shares the news on Facebook. To her surprise, thousands of keyboard activists brutally attack Chris without fully understanding the scope of his accomplishment.

This beautifully produced doc takes a provocative look at the events leading up to the global financial crisis, revealing how the attempt to avoid a ruinous collapse of banks may have set the world on the path to an even bigger meltdown.
Ryan Swan must carve his way through the Hawaiian crime world to wreak vengeance on a kingpin.

title.de: Paul - Ein Alien auf der Flucht

overview.de: So haben sich die begeisterten Science-Ficiton-Fans Graeme (Simon Pegg) und Clive (Nick Frost) ihren Erstkontakt mit einem Alien nicht vorgestellt: Auf ihrer Pilgerfahrt zur legendären Area 51 steht plötzlich der kleine grüne Klugscheißer Paul vor ihnen. Er wird vom FBI gejagt und will möglichst schnell zu seinem Mutterschiff zurück. Natürlich helfen die beiden UFO-Freaks dem flüchtigen Außerirdischen, der ihr Universum für immer verändert und sie vielleicht sogar zu intergalaktischen Helden macht.
overview.en: During a road trip to visit famous UFO sites, two sci-fi geeks encounter a wisecracking alien named Paul who is on the run from federal agents.

Inspired by a 1970s Russian science experiment on fox domestication, Joakim embarks on the art of selective breeding and training, realising his childhood dream of owning his own pack of foxes. However, his pet project abruptly halts when local authorities declare the farm a violation of wildlife law, threatening to euthanize his foxes. To what extent will Joakim go to protect what he holds dear?
A sci-fi anthology series with stand-alone episodes based on the works of Philip K. Dick.
A young singer/songwriter, despite being married, becomes involved with her new guitarist, who she soon discovers has a dark past and may be a danger to her and those close to her.

Veteran bear trainer Jeff Watson takes on perhaps his toughest task in more than 25 years of rescuing and raising the majestic animals. His goal - to reverse the cycle of man's ownership over animals - involves 700-pound grizzlies Bob and Screech, whom he has raised since they were 6 weeks old. Now, after three years, Jeff believes their destiny is to live in the wild, and `Project Grizzly' tracks the trainer's emotional struggle to undo all he has taught the bears in captivity. At a remote Indiana location, Bob and Screech must learn how to hunt, fish and hibernate, and ultimately break their dependence on a human. Unforeseen hurdles lead to some doubt, but Jeff is determined to complete this incredible, dangerous challenge.

After a disastrous first date, wild-child Nicole and socially-anxious Max vow to lose each other’s numbers until they learn that their dogs found a love match, and now puppies are on the way! The hilariously mismatched Nicole and Max are forced to become responsible co-parents, but may end up finding love themselves. Starring Lucy Hale and Grant Gustin.
Bosnia, 1995. When the Serbian army takes over her town, a UN translator becomes a conduit for crucial negotiations as her community seeks shelter.

overview.de: Als ihre Schwester heiratet, kehrt ein ehemaliges Model, das mehrere Entzugskuren hinter sich hat, zurück nach Hause, wo langjährige Familienkonflikte wieder aufflammen.
overview.en: Rachel Getting Married is a contemporary drama with an aggressive sense of humor about the return of an estranged daughter to the family home for her sister's wedding. Kym's (Hathaway) reemergence throws a wrench into the family dynamics, forcing long-simmering tensions to surface in ways both hilarious and heartbreaking. Rachel Getting Married paints a colorful, nuanced family portrait and is ..

Rebellion is the first feature-length documentary to tell the behind the scenes story of Extinction Rebellion from its launch in 2018. With unprecedented access, the film follows a group of unlikely allies and captures the human drama of social movements first hand.
A legendary blind psychic comes out of his 30-year retirement to face his once-fearless adversary in a ghost whisper-debunking paranormal researcher.

overview.de: Knallharter und brutaler Gangsterfilm mit Vinnie Jones (Snatch) und Keith Allen (Kingsman), nach wahren Begebenheiten. Die Nummer 1 in UK. Aufstieg und Fall des Kriegsveteran Tony Tucker vom Türsteher und Schläger zum skrupellosen Gangster. Nachdem er sich mit den berüchtigten Kriminellen Craig Rolfe und Pat Tate verbündet, gerät Tucker immer tiefer in einen Strudel aus Drogen und Gewalt.
overview.en: Returning from the Falklands War, a bitter and angry man soon gets into dangerous dealings as he makes a name for himself in the Essex underworld.

overview.de: Oscargekrönter Boxfilm, der Sylvester Stallone über Nacht zum Superstar machte. - Amateurboxer Rocky (Sylvester Stallone) schlägt sich mit miesen Jobs durch. Für einen Promotion-Gag fordert ihn Boxweltmeister Apollo (Carl Weathers) zum Titelkampf heraus. Doch Rocky nimmt die Sache ernst und trainiert verbissen. Im Ring schlägt die Stunde der Entscheidung.
overview.en: A heavyweight champ gives a club fighter (Sylvester Stallone) a title shot.

overview.de: Das grandiose Finale der Rocky-Reihe: raue Ring-Action mit Sylvester Stallone. - Boxlegende Rocky (Sylvester Stallone) backt inzwischen kleine Brötchen und hält mit Anekdoten die Gäste seines Lokals bei Laune. Dann erklärt ein TV-Sender Rocky zum Sieger eines virtuellen Kampfs gegen den amtierenden Champ. Erneut juckt es den Altboxer in den Fäusten. Mit Schwager Paulie bereitet er sich auf den letzten Kampf seiner Karriere vor.
overview.en: Aging Rocky's plan to fight a few small matches escalates into a battle with the world champion.

title.de: Rocky III - Das Auge des Tigers

overview.de: Stallone boxt sich erneut durch. Mit dem Tophit "Eye of the Tiger". - Weltmeister Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) führt ein Leben in Luxus. Dann fordert ihn der schwarze Boxer Clubber Lang (Mr. T.) heraus. Der Champion verliert den Schwergewichtskampf. Der geschlagene Rocky lässt sich von seinem früheren Gegner Apollo Creed (Carl Weathers) zu einem Comeback überreden.
overview.en: Rocky Balbao teams up with Apollo Creed to regain his title.

Emma (Kaley Cuoco) and Dave (David Oyelowo) spice up their wedding anniversary with a night of role-play in New York City. But things turn perilous when Emma's secret life as an international assassin, unknown to Dave, is exposed by Bob (Bill Nighy), jeopardizing her family. Emma must rely on her lethal skills and determination to protect her family at all costs.
After being diagnosed with multiple sclerosis, a 21-year-old student goes on a journey of self discovery through New Zealand, Burma and Mongolia.
A small-town teen escapes her abusive parents and hitchhikes her way to Vegas, armed only with some pocket money, street smarts, and a gun.
Sean Connery returns to the role that made him famous, James Bond, in this remake of Thunderball.

overview.de: Nach einem schweren Erdbeben der San Andreas-Verwerfung versuchen ein Helikopter-Pilot und seine Frau, sich nach San Francisco zu ihrer Tochter durchzuschlagen, um sie zu retten.
overview.en: A pilot must rescue his daughter after a massive earthquake.
An American army major's love is put to the test by racial prejudices after falling for the beautiful performer of a famed Japanese dancing troupe.

Popular prank TV show, Scare Campaign, has been entertaining audiences for the last 5 years with its mix of old school scares and hidden camera fun. But as we enter a new age of online TV the producers find themselves up against a new hard edged web series which makes their show look decidedly quaint. It's time to up the ante, but will the team go too far this time, and are they about to prank the

title.de: SCHW31NS7EIGER: Memories - Von Anfang bis Legende
title.en: SCHW31NS7EIGER: Memories - Von Anfang bis Legende

overview.en: After the death of her mother, a lonely young girl's grandfather sues for custody and the puppets made by her artist father suddenly come to life.
Sarah Jessica Parker stars in HBO's hit series about a thirtysomething writer whose life and friendships are fodder for her weekly column.

title.de: Sex and the City - Der Film

overview.de: Anwältin Miranda und Charlotte sind verheiratet mit Kind, Vamp Samantha ist für ihren jungen Posterboy nach L.A. gezogen und Autorin Carrie freut sich aufs Wohnen mit Traummann Mr. Big. Dennoch ziehen Gewitter auf. Erst gesteht Mirandas Mann einen One-Night-Stand, dann bekommt Big am Tag der Hochzeit kalte Füße. Der Destruktion folgt eine lange Wiederaufbauphase. Sie beginnt beim Viererurlaub ...
overview.en: Carrie, Samantha, Charlotte, and Miranda are back in this film continuation of the series, set four years after the finale.

title.en: The Coed and the Zombie Stoner

overview.en: When a nerdy sorority girl falls in love with a zombie, it's only a matter of time before a zombie apocalypse is unleashed on campus. The sorority girl discovers that weed is the cure--now she must smoke out the entire school before it's too late.

In this essayistic travelogue, Mirka Duijn explores the history of Shangri-La - the famous paradise from James Hilton's novel, 'Lost Horizon'. Two decades ago, a Tibetan region in China, Deqin, claimed it was the original Shangri-La of legend. This rich and complex story follows Mirka's quest to find answers, only resulting in an entanglement of facts and fictions, truths and lies.

SimsalaGrimm Season 1 (Re-version) takes a fresh look at the heritage of fairy tales. The two witty wanderers Yoyo and Doc Croc travel on their magical book through the enchanted world of Simsala. Despite their differences, they are best friends.

Jimmy Skinford is on the run with the only person he can trust, Zophia, a woman hunted by every crook in town for her coveted immortality. To stop the relentless violence and get their lives back they must search through Zophia’s past to find a cure.
Investigative filmmaker Rebecca Cappelli exposes the harrowing truth behind the use of fur, leather, and wool in the luxury fashion industry.
A law student facing debt and a high tuition bill gets in over his head and meets a zany cast of characters when he breaks the law for cash.
A U.S. Army sniper and his partner try to rescue a congressman abducted by the Taliban. But when the mission fails, they are left behind enemy lines.

A South African love guru loses faith in love after suffering the humiliation of being dumped on her wedding day. However, she meets a Nigerian photographer who is running away from his own love woes. Will he be the one to restore her faith in love and how far is she willing to keep the new love she's found?

title.de: Soulfood - Familie geht durch den Magen

overview.en: A boy with Israeli and Palestinian family that are always at odds tries to bring unity by way of a perfect meal after he is mentored by a gifted chef.
Send in the clowns, this cult classic is back! One-of-a-kind alien invasion sci-fi featuring blood drinking alien clowns harvesting a small city.
A Special Boat Service operative for MI6 and his American counterpart are tasked with scoping an Iranian laboratory making deadly biochemical weapons.
A war vet enters a notorious fight club to avenge the savage beating of his brother and rescue his hometown from the control of a corrupt businessman.
Documentarian Morgan Spurlock opens his very own fast food restaurant in order to investigate and expose the health hazards of the industry.

Ken, a lackadaisical man who has given up on his dreams, finds an outdated, half-broken robot named "Tang" in his backyard. After finding out Tang has no memory of its origin or identity, the two set off on an intercontinental journey to repair Tang and unravel the mystery of its creation. Little did they know a grand adventure was waiting for them...©2022 “TANG AND ME” FILM PARTNERS

title.de: Teen Witch - Hokuspokus in der Highschool

overview.en: On the cusp of her 16th birthday, a high-school nobody discovers she has magical powers that may help her cast a spell on her dream guy.

overview.de: Eine Killermaschine aus der Zukunft wird ins Jahr 1984 geschickt, um Sarah Connor zu töten.
overview.en: Un cyborg asesino viaja al pasado para matar a una mujer cuyo hijo por nacer liderará la lucha humana contra máquinas en una carrera desesperada.
After miraculously healing from a life-threatening illness, a journalist’s search of the ‘lost’ technology that saved him leads him to Nikola Tesla.

According to her detractors, Ruth Paine is a government agent who helped frame Lee Harvey Oswald as the assassin of the president. But to her defenders, she is simply an innocent bystander caught up in history. The Assassination and Mrs Paine juxtaposes Ruth's first-hand account alongside the assassination researchers who suspect her and the defenders of the official story with whom she sides.
In 1962, a United States astronaut of Romanian origins sets out on an unprecedented space quest, where philosophical and emotional incidents occur.

title.de: The Barkley Marathons: The Race That Eats Its Young
title.en: The Barkley Marathons: The Race That Eats Its Young

overview.en: Inspired by an infamous prison escape, runners compete in a cult-like race that’s only had 10 people finish its arduous course in 25 years.

A group of friends travel to a secluded campsite to find a mysterious bell that summons a murderer if you ring it at midnight. They hear ghost stories about the creepy Keeper, who manages the land, killing any kids who dare to ring the haunted bell. After unleashing a malevolent curse, they turn on each other, caught between the relentless Keeper and the looming threat of possession.

Set in gritty London, Olga Kurylenko plays a tough motorbike courier who discovers that one of the packages she's transporting is a bomb set to kill Nick (Amit Shah, Final Score), the only witness able to testify against ruthless crime lord Ezekiel Mannings (Gary Oldman, The Dark Knight). Also starring Dermot Mulroney (Homecoming), William Moseley (Narnia) and Alicia Agneson (Vikings).
Louise and Michael return home to say goodbye to their dying father but soon begin to suffer from a darkness marked by waking nightmares.

overview.de: Der Terrorist Bane bringt Bruce mit seinem skrupellosen Vorgehen dazu, sein selbstgewähltes Exil aufzugeben. Doch selbst mit Cape und Maske, scheint der Dunkle Ritter Bane unterlegen.
